repeated_proposals.note: The signs are explained in varied ways so that the message may be made clear to people who know. This parallels the source section’s movement from what is closed to what is explained, though the ayah does not use the root ش ر ح.

A group hear God’s words and then deliberately distort them after understanding. This is a specific reversal of the source section’s preserved and clarified word: hearing and carrying revelation can also be followed by deliberate alteration.

Some twist their tongues with the Book so listeners think their speech belongs to Scripture, though it does not. This is a concrete misuse of the source section’s tongue-carried Book image, a false publicing rather than faithful transmission.
